ko.title: [국제물류 #9] 6만 달러짜리 화물은 무사히 날았는데, 항공사는 왜 7천 달러만 배상하면 될까?

segments.src: > Air cargo is fast but costly, and it runs on three things: a contract document (the air waybill), standardized containers (ULDs), and an international treaty (the Montreal Convention) that caps what an airline pays if something goes wrong.
segments.tr: > 항공 화물은 빠르지만 비용이 많이 들며, 세 가지 요소로 작동합니다: 계약 문서인 항공화물운송장(AWB), 표준화된 컨테이너(ULD), 그리고 사고 발생 시 항공사가 지급할 금액의 상한을 정한 국제 협약(몬트리올 협약)입니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Less than 1% of world trade by weight moves by air, yet that slice accounts for roughly a third of global trade by value.
segments.tr: 세계 무역을 중량으로 따지면 항공으로 운송되는 비중은 1%에 못 미치지만, 그 일부가 가치 기준으로는 전 세계 무역의 약 3분의 1을 차지합니다.

segments.src: That makes sense: you fly things that are light, valuable, perishable, or urgent, such as smartphones, pharmaceuticals, fresh flowers, or a replacement part for a stalled factory line.
segments.tr: 이는 당연한 결과입니다. 스마트폰, 의약품, 생화, 또는 멈춰 선 공장 라인에 필요한 교체 부품처럼 가볍고, 가치가 높고, 변질되기 쉽거나 긴급한 물건을 항공으로 보내기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Three building blocks keep this system running.
segments.tr: 이 시스템을 움직이는 세 가지 핵심 요소가 있습니다.

segments.src: The Air Waybill (AWB): the contract and the receipt.**
segments.tr: 항공화물운송장(AWB): 계약서이자 영수증입니다.**

segments.src: Every air shipment travels under an AWB.
segments.tr: 모든 항공 화물은 AWB를 발행받아 운송됩니다.

segments.src: It shows that the airline received the goods, lays out the terms of carriage, and lists the shipper, consignee, weight, pieces, and charges.
segments.tr: AWB는 항공사가 화물을 수령했음을 증명하고, 운송 조건을 명시하며, 송하인, 수하인, 중량, 개수, 운임 등을 기재합니다.

segments.src: Each AWB has an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: 각 AWB에는 11자리 번호가 있습니다.

segments.src: The first three digits are the airline's prefix (for example, 001 is American Airlines), and the remaining eight identify the shipment, so you can track it from start to finish.
segments.tr: 앞 세 자리는 항공사 코드(예: 001은 아메리칸 항공)이고, 나머지 여덟 자리는 화물을 식별하므로 출발부터 도착까지 추적할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: One key difference from ocean shipping: **an AWB is not a document of title.** A negotiable ocean bill of lading can be sold or handed over to transfer ownership of the goods.
segments.tr: 해상 운송과의 중요한 차이점: **AWB는 권리증권이 아닙니다.** 유통성 해상 선하증권(B/L)은 판매하거나 넘겨줘서 화물의 소유권을 이전할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: AWB는 그렇게 할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: 화물은 AWB에 기재된 수하인에게 인도됩니다.

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: 비행기는 몇 주가 아니라 몇 시간이면 도착하기 때문에, 운송 중에 화물을 거래할 필요가 거의 없습니다.

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: 또한 두 가지 유형의 운송장에 대해서도 듣게 될 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **마스터 AWB(MAWB)**: 항공사가 포워더에게 발행하며, 흔히 여러 고객의 화물을 혼재한 것을 포괄합니다.

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **하우스 AWB(HAWB)**: 포워더가 개별 송하인에게 발행합니다.

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: 오늘날 대부분의 AWB는 종이 대신 전자 방식(e-AWB)입니다.

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULD(Unit Load Device): 화물칸의 기본 단위입니다.**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: 항공기 화물칸은 곡선형이고 빈틈없이 채워야 하므로, 표준 40피트 해상 컨테이너를 그대로 밀어 넣을 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: 그래서 항공사는 대신 ULD를 사용합니다.

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: ULD는 그물이 달린 알루미늄 파렛트이거나, 동체 형태에 맞게 윤곽을 준 컨테이너입니다.

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: 대표적인 예가 **LD3**로, 보잉 777 같은 광동체 여객기의 하부 데크에 두 개가 나란히 들어가는 컨테이너입니다.

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: ULD를 쓰면 지상 작업자가 수백 개의 상자를 하나의 단위로 실을 수 있어, 적재 시간과 취급 중 파손을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: 항공 화물의 운임 산정: 과금중량.**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: 항공기의 적재 공간은 무게뿐 아니라 부피로도 제한됩니다.

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: 따라서 항공사는 실제 중량과 상자 크기를 기준으로 한 「용적중량」 중 큰 쪽을 기준으로 요금을 부과합니다.

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: 일반적인 IATA 기준은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: 부피가 큰 베개 상자는 저울에 찍힌 무게로 예상하는 것보다 항공 운임이 훨씬 많이 나올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: 몬트리올 협약(1999): 문제가 생겼을 때 누가 배상하는가.**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: 이 국제 조약은 대부분의 국제 항공 운송에 적용되며, 미국도 당사국입니다.

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: 당사국입니다.

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: 화물에 관한 주요 규칙은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - 항공사는 운송 중 화물의 멸실, 분실, 손상에 대해 **과실 여부와 관계없이** 책임을 집니다. 면책은 다음과 같은 명시된 사유에 한해서만 인정됩니다. 예를 들어 화물 자체의 고유 결함, 운송인이 아닌 자의 부적절한 포장, 전쟁, 또는 공권력의 행위(예: 세관) 등입니다.

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - 책임 한도는 **킬로그램당**으로 정해지며, IMF 단위인 특별인출권(SDR, 여러 통화를 바탕으로 한 바스켓 기준)으로 측정합니다. 한도는 약 5년마다 재검토됩니다. 현재는 **kg당 26 SDR**이며, 2024년 12월에 인상되었습니다. 환율에 따라 대략 kg당 35달러 정도입니다.

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - 화물의 경우 항공사에 중대한 과실이 있더라도 이 상한은 **그대로 적용됩니다.** 이를 우회하는 방법은 운송 시 더 높은 가액을 신고하고 추가 요금을 내는 것, 또는 별도의 화물보험에 가입하는 것뿐입니다.

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - 기한은 엄격합니다. 파손의 경우 화물 수령 후 **14일** 이내, 지연의 경우 **21일** 이내에 서면 이의제기를 해야 하며, 소송은 **2년** 이내에 제기해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속 사례

segments.src: A medical-device startup in Columbus, Ohio, sells precision sensor modules to a hospital group in Germany.
segments.tr: 오하이오주 컬럼버스의 한 의료기기 스타트업이 독일의 병원 그룹에 정밀 센서 모듈을 판매합니다.

segments.src: The order is 200 kg of modules worth **$60,000**, flown from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt.
segments.tr: 주문량은 200kg의 모듈로 가치는 **6만 달러**이며, 시카고 오헤어 공항에서 프랑크푸르트로 항공 운송됩니다.

segments.src: Their freight forwarder consolidates the shipment with other customers' freight under one master AWB and gives the startup a house AWB.
segments.tr: 포워더는 이 화물을 마스터 AWB 하나로 다른 고객의 화물과 혼재하고, 스타트업에는 하우스 AWB를 발행합니다.

segments.src: At O'Hare, the boxes go into an LD3 container on a 777.
segments.tr: 오헤어 공항에서 상자들은 보잉 777의 LD3 컨테이너에 실립니다.

segments.src: During transit a forklift punctures the container, and half the modules are crushed.
segments.tr: 운송 중 지게차가 컨테이너에 구멍을 내어, 모듈의 절반이 파손됩니다.

segments.src: The hospital notes the damage on delivery, and the startup files a written claim within 14 days.
segments.tr: 병원은 인수 시 손상을 기록하고, 스타트업은 14일 이내에 서면으로 청구합니다.

segments.src: The airline is liable even without proof of fault.
segments.tr: 항공사는 과실 입증 없이도 책임을 집니다.

segments.src: But the payout is capped:
segments.tr: 하지만 지급액에는 상한이 있습니다:

segments.src: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000
segments.tr: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000

segments.src: That covers roughly **$7,000 of a $30,000 loss.** If the startup had declared a higher value on the AWB, or simply bought an all-risk cargo insurance policy (often a small fraction of a percent of the cargo value), it could have recovered close to the full amount.
segments.tr: 이는 **3만 달러 손실 중 약 7천 달러**에 해당합니다. 만약 스타트업이 AWB에 더 높은 가액을 신고했거나, 올리스크(all-risk) 화물보험(보통 화물 가액의 극히 일부인 소액)에 가입했다면, 거의 전액을 보상받을 수 있었을 것입니다.

segments.src: The lesson for anyone shipping high-value, lightweight goods is that the per-kilo cap is not built to protect you.
segments.tr: 고가의 가벼운 물건을 운송하는 모든 이에게 주는 교훈은, kg당 상한은 여러분을 보호하기 위해 만들어진 것이 아니라는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3줄 요약

segments.src: 1. The **air waybill** is the contract and receipt for air cargo. Unlike an ocean bill of lading, it is non-negotiable, and the goods go to the named consignee.
segments.tr: 1. **항공화물운송장**은 항공 화물의 계약서이자 영수증입니다. 해상 선하증권과 달리 양도가 불가능하며, 화물은 기재된 수하인에게 인도됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **ULDs** are pallets and containers shaped to fit aircraft holds, and freight is priced on **chargeable weight**, whichever is greater of actual or volumetric weight.
segments.tr: 2. **ULD**는 항공기 화물칸에 맞춰 만든 파렛트와 컨테이너이며, 운임은 실제 중량과 용적중량 중 큰 쪽인 **과금중량**을 기준으로 산정됩니다.

segments.src: 3. Under the **Montreal Convention**, airlines are liable for cargo damage without proof of fault but only up to **26 SDRs/kg**. For valuable goods, declare a higher value or insure them.
segments.tr: 3. **몬트리올 협약**에 따라 항공사는 과실 입증 없이도 화물 손해에 책임을 지지만, 그 한도는 **kg당 26 SDR**입니다. 고가의 화물이라면 더 높은 가액을 신고하거나 보험에 가입하십시오.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Air Waybill (AWB)**: A non-negotiable contract of carriage and receipt for goods shipped by air, identified by an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: - **항공화물운송장(AWB)**: 항공으로 운송되는 화물에 대한 양도 불가능한 운송 계약서이자 수령증으로, 11자리 번호로 식별됩니다.

segments.src: - **Master / House AWB**: The airline-to-forwarder waybill (master) and the forwarder-to-shipper waybill (house) used in consolidated shipments.
segments.tr: - **마스터 / 하우스 AWB**: 혼재 화물에서 쓰이는, 항공사가 포워더에게 발행하는 운송장(마스터)과 포워더가 송하인에게 발행하는 운송장(하우스)입니다.

segments.src: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: A standardized aircraft pallet or container, such as the LD3, used to load cargo as a single unit.
segments.tr: - **ULD(Unit Load Device)**: 화물을 하나의 단위로 싣는 데 쓰이는, LD3 등 표준화된 항공기 파렛트 또는 컨테이너입니다.

segments.src: - **Chargeable weight**: Whichever is greater of actual weight and volumetric weight; the figure air freight is billed on.
segments.tr: - **과금중량(Chargeable weight)**: 실제 중량과 용적중량 중 큰 쪽으로, 항공 운임이 청구되는 기준 중량입니다.

segments.src: - **Montreal Convention (1999)**: The international treaty setting airline liability rules, including a per-kg cap (currently 26 SDRs) for cargo loss, damage, or delay.
segments.tr: - **몬트리올 협약(1999)**: 항공사 책임 규칙을 정한 국제 조약으로, 화물의 멸실·손상·지연에 대한 kg당 한도(현재 26 SDR)를 포함합니다.

zh.title: [国际物流 #9] 你的 60,000 美元货物安全飞抵——那航空公司为什么只需赔 7,000 美元？

segments.src: > Air cargo is fast but costly, and it runs on three things: a contract document (the air waybill), standardized containers (ULDs), and an international treaty (the Montreal Convention) that caps what an airline pays if something goes wrong.
segments.tr: > 航空货运速度快但成本高，它依赖三样东西：一份合同文件（航空运单）、标准化集装箱（ULD），以及一项国际公约（《蒙特利尔公约》），后者规定了货物出事时航空公司最多需要赔付的金额。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Less than 1% of world trade by weight moves by air, yet that slice accounts for roughly a third of global trade by value.
segments.tr: 按重量计，全球贸易中只有不到 1% 通过航空运输，但这一小部分占全球贸易总额的约三分之一（按价值计）。

segments.src: That makes sense: you fly things that are light, valuable, perishable, or urgent, such as smartphones, pharmaceuticals, fresh flowers, or a replacement part for a stalled factory line.
segments.tr: 这并不奇怪：通过飞机运输的通常是轻便、高价值、易腐或紧急的物品，例如智能手机、药品、鲜花，或是停产生产线急需的替换零件。

segments.src: Three building blocks keep this system running.
segments.tr: 支撑这一体系的有三个基本要素。

segments.src: The Air Waybill (AWB): the contract and the receipt.**
segments.tr: 航空运单（AWB）：合同与收据。**

segments.src: Every air shipment travels under an AWB.
segments.tr: 每一票航空货物都凭航空运单（AWB）运输。

segments.src: It shows that the airline received the goods, lays out the terms of carriage, and lists the shipper, consignee, weight, pieces, and charges.
segments.tr: 它证明航空公司已收到货物，列明运输条款，并列出托运人、收货人、重量、件数和费用。

segments.src: Each AWB has an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: 每份航空运单都有一个 11 位数字编号。

segments.src: The first three digits are the airline's prefix (for example, 001 is American Airlines), and the remaining eight identify the shipment, so you can track it from start to finish.
segments.tr: 前三位是航空公司代码（例如 001 代表美国航空），其余八位标识该票货物，便于从头到尾追踪。

segments.src: One key difference from ocean shipping: **an AWB is not a document of title.** A negotiable ocean bill of lading can be sold or handed over to transfer ownership of the goods.
segments.tr: 与海运的一个关键区别：**航空运单不是物权凭证。** 可转让的海运提单可以出售或背书转让，从而转移货物所有权。

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: 航空运单则不行。

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: 货物会交付给运单上载明的收货人。

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: 因为飞机以小时而非周计算时间，货物在运输途中无需进行买卖交易。

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: 你还会听到两种运单：

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **主运单（MAWB）**：由航空公司签发给货运代理，通常涵盖多个客户拼箱合并的货物。

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **分运单（HAWB）**：由货运代理签发给每位托运人。

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: 如今大多数航空运单已是电子形式（e-AWB），而非纸质。

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULD（单元载货装置）：货舱的基本组成单元。**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: 飞机货舱呈弧形且空间紧凑，因此不能直接装入标准的 40 英尺海运集装箱。

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: 航空公司改用 ULD。

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: 这些是带网罩的铝制托盘，或按机身轮廓定制的异形集装箱。

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: 常见的例子是 **LD3**，这种集装箱在波音 777 等宽体客机的下货舱可以两个并排装载。

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: ULD 让地勤人员能把数百个箱子作为一个整体装卸，从而减少装卸时间和搬运损坏。

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: 航空货运的计费方式：计费重量。**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: 飞机的载运空间既受重量限制，也受体积限制。

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: 因此航空公司按两者中较大的一项收费：实际重量，或根据箱体尺寸计算的“体积重量”。

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: 依据国际航空运输协会（IATA）的通用标准：

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: 一大箱枕头的航空运费，可能远高于它在秤上显示的重量所暗示的金额。

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: 《蒙特利尔公约》（1999）：出问题时由谁承担。**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: 这项国际条约规范大多数国际航空运输，美国

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: 是该条约的缔约方。

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: 就货物而言，主要规则如下：

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - 承运人对运输途中的毁损、灭失或损坏负责，**无论其是否有过错**。只有在法定事由下才可免责，例如货物固有缺陷、承运人以外的人包装不当、战争，或政府行为（例如海关）。

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - 赔偿责任**按公斤封顶**，以特别提款权（SDR）计价，SDR 是国际货币基金组织以一篮子货币为基础的记账单位。该限额约每五年审议一次。目前为**每公斤 26 SDR**，于 2024 年 12 月提高，按汇率不同约合每公斤 35 美元左右。

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - 就货物而言，即使承运人存在严重过失，该上限仍然适用。唯一的例外途径是在托运时申报更高的价值并支付附加费，或另行购买货物保险。

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - 时限非常严格：货损的书面索赔须在收到货物之日起 **14 天**内提出，延误的书面索赔须在 **21 天**内提出，诉讼须在 **2 年**内提起。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的例子

segments.src: A medical-device startup in Columbus, Ohio, sells precision sensor modules to a hospital group in Germany.
segments.tr: 一家位于美国俄亥俄州哥伦布市的医疗器械初创公司，向德国的一家医院集团出售精密传感器模块。

segments.src: The order is 200 kg of modules worth **$60,000**, flown from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt.
segments.tr: 此次订单为 200 公斤模块，价值 **60,000 美元**，从芝加哥奥黑尔机场空运至法兰克福。

segments.src: Their freight forwarder consolidates the shipment with other customers' freight under one master AWB and gives the startup a house AWB.
segments.tr: 他们的货运代理将这批货与其他客户的货物拼箱，以一份主运单运输，并为该初创公司签发一份分运单。

segments.src: At O'Hare, the boxes go into an LD3 container on a 777.
segments.tr: 在奥黑尔机场，箱子被装入一个 LD3 集装箱，装上 777 客机。

segments.src: During transit a forklift punctures the container, and half the modules are crushed.
segments.tr: 运输途中，一台叉车刺穿了集装箱，一半模块被压坏。

segments.src: The hospital notes the damage on delivery, and the startup files a written claim within 14 days.
segments.tr: 医院在收货时注明了损坏情况，该初创公司在 14 天内提交了书面索赔。

segments.src: The airline is liable even without proof of fault.
segments.tr: 即使无法证明过失，航空公司仍需承担赔偿责任。

segments.src: But the payout is capped:
segments.tr: 但赔付金额有上限：

segments.src: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000
segments.tr: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000

segments.src: That covers roughly **$7,000 of a $30,000 loss.** If the startup had declared a higher value on the AWB, or simply bought an all-risk cargo insurance policy (often a small fraction of a percent of the cargo value), it could have recovered close to the full amount.
segments.tr: 这大约只能覆盖 **30,000 美元损失中的 7,000 美元。** 如果该初创公司在航空运单上申报了更高的价值，或者干脆购买了全险货运保险（保费通常只占货值的极小比例），它本可以追回接近全部损失的金额。

segments.src: The lesson for anyone shipping high-value, lightweight goods is that the per-kilo cap is not built to protect you.
segments.tr: 对于高价值、轻量货物的托运人而言，这一经验是：每公斤限额并不是为保护你而设计的。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. The **air waybill** is the contract and receipt for air cargo. Unlike an ocean bill of lading, it is non-negotiable, and the goods go to the named consignee.
segments.tr: 1. **航空运单**是航空货运的合同与收据。与海运提单不同，它不可转让，货物交付给运单上载明的收货人。

segments.src: 2. **ULDs** are pallets and containers shaped to fit aircraft holds, and freight is priced on **chargeable weight**, whichever is greater of actual or volumetric weight.
segments.tr: 2. **ULD** 是按飞机货舱尺寸制造的托盘和集装箱；运费按**计费重量**计算，即实际重量与体积重量两者中取较大者。

segments.src: 3. Under the **Montreal Convention**, airlines are liable for cargo damage without proof of fault but only up to **26 SDRs/kg**. For valuable goods, declare a higher value or insure them.
segments.tr: 3. 根据**《蒙特利尔公约》**，航空公司对货物损坏承担赔偿责任无需证明过失，但赔偿上限为**每公斤 26 SDR**。对于贵重物品，应申报更高价值或投保。

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Air Waybill (AWB)**: A non-negotiable contract of carriage and receipt for goods shipped by air, identified by an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: - **航空运单（AWB）**：航空运输货物的不可转让运输合同兼收据，以 11 位数字编号标识。

segments.src: - **Master / House AWB**: The airline-to-forwarder waybill (master) and the forwarder-to-shipper waybill (house) used in consolidated shipments.
segments.tr: - **主运单 / 分运单**：主运单为航空公司签发给货运代理的运单，分运单为货运代理签发给托运人的运单，两者用于拼箱运输。

segments.src: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: A standardized aircraft pallet or container, such as the LD3, used to load cargo as a single unit.
segments.tr: - **ULD（单元载货装置）**：标准化的飞机托盘或集装箱（例如 LD3），用于将货物作为一个整体装载。

segments.src: - **Chargeable weight**: Whichever is greater of actual weight and volumetric weight; the figure air freight is billed on.
segments.tr: - **计费重量**：实际重量与体积重量两者中的较大者，即航空运费据以计算的重量。

segments.src: - **Montreal Convention (1999)**: The international treaty setting airline liability rules, including a per-kg cap (currently 26 SDRs) for cargo loss, damage, or delay.
segments.tr: - **《蒙特利尔公约》（1999）**：规定航空公司责任的国际条约，包括对货物毁损、灭失或延误设定的每公斤赔偿上限（目前为 26 SDR）。

segments.tr: समुद्री शिपिंग से एक मुख्य अंतर: **AWB स्वामित्व का दस्तावेज़ नहीं है।** हस्तांतरणीय समुद्री बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग को बेचा या सौंपा जा सकता है और इससे माल का स्वामित्व बदलता है।

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: AWB के साथ ऐसा नहीं होता।

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: माल उस प्राप्तकर्ता (consignee) को सौंपा जाता है जिसका नाम उस पर लिखा है।

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: चूँकि विमान हफ़्तों में नहीं, घंटों में पहुँचते हैं, इसलिए पारगमन के दौरान किसी को माल का व्यापार करने की ज़रूरत नहीं होती।

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: आपको वेबिल की दो परतों के बारे में भी सुनने को मिलेगा:

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **मास्टर AWB (MAWB)**: एयरलाइन द्वारा फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर को जारी किया जाता है, जो अक्सर कई ग्राहकों के सामान को एकत्र करके कवर करता है।

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **हाउस AWB (HAWB)**: फ़ॉरवर्डर द्वारा हर अलग भेजने वाले को जारी किया जाता है।

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: आज ज़्यादातर AWB कागज़ की बजाय इलेक्ट्रॉनिक (e-AWB) होते हैं।

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULD (Unit Load Devices): कार्गो होल्ड की बुनियादी इकाइयाँ।**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: विमान के होल्ड घुमावदार और कसकर भरे होते हैं, इसलिए आप मानक 40 फ़ुट के समुद्री कंटेनर को सीधे अंदर नहीं डाल सकते।

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: इसलिए एयरलाइनें ULD का उपयोग करती हैं।

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: ये जाल वाले एल्युमिनियम पैलेट होते हैं, या फ़्यूज़लेज के आकार में ढले हुए कंटूर्ड कंटेनर।

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: एक आम उदाहरण **LD3** है, एक ऐसा कंटेनर जो Boeing 777 जैसे वाइड-बॉडी जेट के निचले डेक में दो-दो की कतार में फ़िट होता है।

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: ULD की वजह से ग्राउंड क्रू सैकड़ों बॉक्स को एक ही इकाई के रूप में लोड कर सकते हैं, जिससे लोडिंग का समय और हैंडलिंग में होने वाला नुकसान दोनों कम होते हैं।

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: हवाई माल का मूल्य कैसे तय होता है: चार्जेबल वज़न।**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: विमान में जगह वज़न के साथ-साथ आयतन (volume) से भी सीमित होती है।

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: इसलिए एयरलाइनें दोनों में से जो भी अधिक हो उसके आधार पर शुल्क लेती हैं: वास्तविक वज़न, या बॉक्स के आकार पर आधारित "वॉल्यूमेट्रिक वज़न"।

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: सामान्य IATA मानक के तहत:

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: पिलो का एक बड़ा बॉक्स, उसके तराज़ू पर दिखने वाले वज़न से कहीं ज़्यादा शुल्क पर उड़ सकता है।

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: मॉन्ट्रियल कन्वेंशन (1999): गड़बड़ होने पर कौन भुगतान करेगा।**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: यह अंतरराष्ट्रीय संधि अधिकांश अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई परिवहन को नियंत्रित करती है, और अमेरिका

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: इसका पक्षकार है।

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: कार्गो के लिए मुख्य नियम हैं:

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - एयरलाइन परिवहन के दौरान माल के नष्ट होने, खोने या क्षतिग्रस्त होने के लिए उत्तरदायी है, **चाहे उसकी गलती हो या न हो**। वह केवल सूचीबद्ध कारणों से ही दायित्व से बच सकती है, जैसे सामान में अंतर्निहित दोष, वाहक के अलावा किसी और द्वारा दोषपूर्ण पैकिंग, युद्ध, या सरकारी प्राधिकरणों के कार्य (जैसे सीमा शुल्क)।

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - दायित्व **प्रति किलोग्राम** सीमित है, जो विशेष आहरण अधिकार (SDR) में मापा जाता है, यह IMF की एक इकाई है जो मुद्राओं की एक टोकरी पर आधारित है। यह सीमा लगभग हर पाँच साल में समीक्षा की जाती है। यह अभी **प्रति किलो 26 SDR** है, जो दिसंबर 2024 में बढ़ाई गई थी, और विनिमय दरों के आधार पर लगभग $35 प्रति किलो बैठती है।

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - कार्गो के लिए, यह सीमा **तब भी लागू रहती है जब एयरलाइन गंभीर लापरवाही की दोषी हो**। इससे बचने के केवल दो तरीके हैं: शिपिंग के समय अधिक मूल्य घोषित करना और अतिरिक्त शुल्क चुकाना, या अलग से कार्गो बीमा खरीदना।

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - समय-सीमाएँ सख़्त हैं: क्षति के लिए लिखित शिकायत प्राप्ति के **14 दिनों** के भीतर, और देरी के लिए **21 दिनों** के भीतर देनी होती है, और मुकदमा **2 वर्षों** के भीतर दायर करना होता है।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में

segments.src: A medical-device startup in Columbus, Ohio, sells precision sensor modules to a hospital group in Germany.
segments.tr: ओहायो के कोलंबस में एक मेडिकल-डिवाइस स्टार्टअप जर्मनी के एक अस्पताल समूह को सटीक सेंसर मॉड्यूल बेचता है।

segments.src: The order is 200 kg of modules worth **$60,000**, flown from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt.
segments.tr: ऑर्डर 200 किलो मॉड्यूल का है, जिनकी कीमत **$60,000** है, और इन्हें शिकागो O'Hare से फ़्रैंकफ़र्ट भेजा जाना है।

segments.src: Their freight forwarder consolidates the shipment with other customers' freight under one master AWB and gives the startup a house AWB.
segments.tr: उनका फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर इस शिपमेंट को दूसरे ग्राहकों के फ़्रेट के साथ एक मास्टर AWB के तहत मिलाता है, और स्टार्टअप को एक हाउस AWB देता है।

segments.src: At O'Hare, the boxes go into an LD3 container on a 777.
segments.tr: O'Hare पर, बॉक्स 777 विमान पर एक LD3 कंटेनर में रखे जाते हैं।

segments.src: During transit a forklift punctures the container, and half the modules are crushed.
segments.tr: परिवहन के दौरान एक फ़ोर्कलिफ़्ट कंटेनर में छेद कर देती है, और आधे मॉड्यूल कुचल जाते हैं।

segments.src: The hospital notes the damage on delivery, and the startup files a written claim within 14 days.
segments.tr: अस्पताल डिलीवरी के समय क्षति दर्ज करता है, और स्टार्टअप 14 दिनों के भीतर लिखित दावा दायर करता है।

segments.src: The airline is liable even without proof of fault.
segments.tr: एयरलाइन गलती के सबूत के बिना भी उत्तरदायी है।

segments.src: But the payout is capped:
segments.tr: लेकिन भुगतान की सीमा तय है:

segments.src: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000
segments.tr: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000

segments.src: That covers roughly **$7,000 of a $30,000 loss.** If the startup had declared a higher value on the AWB, or simply bought an all-risk cargo insurance policy (often a small fraction of a percent of the cargo value), it could have recovered close to the full amount.
segments.tr: यह लगभग **$30,000 के नुकसान में से $7,000** को कवर करता है। अगर स्टार्टअप ने AWB पर अधिक मूल्य घोषित किया होता, या बस एक ऑल-रिस्क कार्गो बीमा पॉलिसी खरीदी होती (जो अक्सर माल के मूल्य का एक छोटा सा अंश होती है), तो वह लगभग पूरी रकम वसूल सकता था।

segments.src: The lesson for anyone shipping high-value, lightweight goods is that the per-kilo cap is not built to protect you.
segments.tr: उच्च मूल्य वाले, हल्के सामान भेजने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति के लिए सबक यह है कि प्रति-किलो सीमा आपकी सुरक्षा के लिए नहीं बनी है।

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. The **air waybill** is the contract and receipt for air cargo. Unlike an ocean bill of lading, it is non-negotiable, and the goods go to the named consignee.
segments.tr: 1. **एयर वेबिल** हवाई कार्गो के लिए अनुबंध और रसीद है। समुद्री बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग के विपरीत, यह गैर-हस्तांतरणीय है, और माल नामित प्राप्तकर्ता तक जाता है।

segments.src: 2. **ULDs** are pallets and containers shaped to fit aircraft holds, and freight is priced on **chargeable weight**, whichever is greater of actual or volumetric weight.
segments.tr: 2. **ULD** विमान के होल्ड में फ़िट होने के लिए ढले पैलेट और कंटेनर हैं, और फ़्रेट का शुल्क **चार्जेबल वज़न** पर तय होता है, यानी वास्तविक और वॉल्यूमेट्रिक वज़न में से जो भी अधिक हो।

segments.src: 3. Under the **Montreal Convention**, airlines are liable for cargo damage without proof of fault but only up to **26 SDRs/kg**. For valuable goods, declare a higher value or insure them.
segments.tr: 3. **मॉन्ट्रियल कन्वेंशन** के तहत, एयरलाइनें बिना गलती सिद्ध हुए कार्गो क्षति के लिए उत्तरदायी हैं, लेकिन केवल **26 SDR/किग्रा** तक। मूल्यवान सामान के लिए, अधिक मूल्य घोषित करें या बीमा कराएँ।

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज के शब्द

segments.src: - **Air Waybill (AWB)**: A non-negotiable contract of carriage and receipt for goods shipped by air, identified by an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: - **एयर वेबिल (AWB)**: हवाई मार्ग से भेजे गए माल के लिए एक गैर-हस्तांतरणीय परिवहन अनुबंध और रसीद, जिसकी पहचान 11 अंकों के नंबर से होती है।

segments.src: - **Master / House AWB**: The airline-to-forwarder waybill (master) and the forwarder-to-shipper waybill (house) used in consolidated shipments.
segments.tr: - **मास्टर / हाउस AWB**: एकत्रित शिपमेंट में उपयोग होने वाला, एयरलाइन-से-फ़ॉरवर्डर वेबिल (मास्टर) और फ़ॉरवर्डर-से-भेजने वाला वेबिल (हाउस)।

segments.src: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: A standardized aircraft pallet or container, such as the LD3, used to load cargo as a single unit.
segments.tr: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: एक मानकीकृत विमान पैलेट या कंटेनर, जैसे LD3, जिसमें माल को एक इकाई के रूप में लोड किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Chargeable weight**: Whichever is greater of actual weight and volumetric weight; the figure air freight is billed on.
segments.tr: - **चार्जेबल वज़न**: वास्तविक वज़न और वॉल्यूमेट्रिक वज़न में से जो भी अधिक हो; वह आँकड़ा जिस पर एयर फ़्रेट का बिल बनता है।

segments.src: - **Montreal Convention (1999)**: The international treaty setting airline liability rules, including a per-kg cap (currently 26 SDRs) for cargo loss, damage, or delay.
segments.tr: - **मॉन्ट्रियल कन्वेंशन (1999)**: एयरलाइन दायित्व के नियम तय करने वाली अंतरराष्ट्रीय संधि, जिसमें कार्गो के नुकसान, क्षति या देरी के लिए प्रति-किलो सीमा (वर्तमान में 26 SDR) शामिल है।

es.title: [Logística internacional #9] Su envío de $60,000 voló bien, entonces ¿por qué la aerolínea solo le debería pagar $7,000?

segments.src: > Air cargo is fast but costly, and it runs on three things: a contract document (the air waybill), standardized containers (ULDs), and an international treaty (the Montreal Convention) that caps what an airline pays if something goes wrong.
segments.tr: > El transporte aéreo de carga es rápido pero caro, y se apoya en tres elementos: un documento contractual (la guía aérea, *air waybill*), contenedores estandarizados (ULD) y un tratado internacional (el Convenio de Montreal) que limita lo que una aerolínea paga si algo sale mal.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Less than 1% of world trade by weight moves by air, yet that slice accounts for roughly a third of global trade by value.
segments.tr: Menos del 1 % del comercio mundial en peso se mueve por vía aérea, pero esa pequeña porción representa aproximadamente un tercio del comercio mundial en valor.

segments.src: That makes sense: you fly things that are light, valuable, perishable, or urgent, such as smartphones, pharmaceuticals, fresh flowers, or a replacement part for a stalled factory line.
segments.tr: Tiene sentido: por avión se envían cosas ligeras, valiosas, perecederas o urgentes, como teléfonos inteligentes, productos farmacéuticos, flores frescas o una pieza de repuesto para una línea de fábrica detenida.

segments.src: Three building blocks keep this system running.
segments.tr: Tres componentes básicos mantienen en funcionamiento este sistema.

segments.src: The Air Waybill (AWB): the contract and the receipt.**
segments.tr: La guía aérea (AWB): el contrato y el recibo.**

segments.src: Every air shipment travels under an AWB.
segments.tr: Todo envío aéreo viaja bajo una AWB.

segments.src: It shows that the airline received the goods, lays out the terms of carriage, and lists the shipper, consignee, weight, pieces, and charges.
segments.tr: Demuestra que la aerolínea recibió la mercancía, establece las condiciones del transporte y enumera al remitente, al consignatario, el peso, los bultos y los cargos.

segments.src: Each AWB has an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: Cada AWB tiene un número de 11 dígitos.

segments.src: The first three digits are the airline's prefix (for example, 001 is American Airlines), and the remaining eight identify the shipment, so you can track it from start to finish.
segments.tr: Los tres primeros dígitos son el prefijo de la aerolínea (por ejemplo, 001 corresponde a American Airlines), y los ocho restantes identifican el envío, de modo que puede rastrearse de principio a fin.

segments.src: One key difference from ocean shipping: **an AWB is not a document of title.** A negotiable ocean bill of lading can be sold or handed over to transfer ownership of the goods.
segments.tr: Una diferencia clave con el transporte marítimo: **la AWB no es un título de propiedad.** Un conocimiento de embarque marítimo negociable puede venderse o entregarse para transferir la propiedad de la mercancía.

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: La AWB no.

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: La carga se entrega al consignatario que figura en ella.

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: Como los aviones llegan en horas, no en semanas, nadie necesita negociar la mercancía mientras está en tránsito.

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: También oirá hablar de dos niveles de guías aéreas:

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **AWB madre (MAWB)**: la emite la aerolínea a un agente de carga y a menudo cubre mercancía de muchos clientes consolidada.

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **AWB casa (HAWB)**: la emite el agente de carga a cada remitente individual.

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: Hoy la mayoría de las AWB son electrónicas (e-AWB) en lugar de papel.

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULD (Unit Load Devices): los componentes básicos de la bodega de carga.**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: Las bodegas de los aviones son curvas y están muy ajustadas, así que no se puede introducir sin más un contenedor marítimo estándar de 40 pies.

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: Las aerolíneas usan en su lugar ULD.

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: Son palés de aluminio con redes o contenedores con el contorno ajustado al fuselaje.

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: Un ejemplo común es el **LD3**, un contenedor que cabe dos en fila en la cubierta inferior de aviones de fuselaje ancho como el Boeing 777.

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: Los ULD permiten que el personal de tierra cargue cientos de cajas como una sola unidad, lo que reduce el tiempo de carga y los daños por manipulación.

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: Cómo se fija el precio del flete aéreo: el peso tarifable.**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: El espacio en un avión está limitado tanto por el volumen como por el peso.

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: Por eso las aerolíneas cobran según lo que resulte mayor: el peso real o el «peso volumétrico» basado en el tamaño de la caja.

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: Según el estándar común de la IATA:

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: Una caja grande de almohadas puede costar mucho más de transportar de lo que sugiere su peso en la báscula.

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: El Convenio de Montreal (1999): quién paga cuando algo sale mal.**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: Este tratado internacional rige la mayor parte del transporte aéreo internacional, y Estados Unidos

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: es parte en él.

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: En cuanto a la carga, las reglas principales son:

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - La aerolínea es responsable de la destrucción, pérdida o daño durante el transporte, **tenga o no culpa**. Solo queda exonerada por causas enumeradas, como un defecto intrínseco de la mercancía, un embalaje defectuoso realizado por alguien distinto del transportista, la guerra o los actos de las autoridades públicas (por ejemplo, aduanas).

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - La responsabilidad está **limitada por kilogramo**, medida en Derechos Especiales de Giro (DEG), una unidad del FMI basada en una cesta de monedas. El límite se revisa aproximadamente cada cinco años. Actualmente es de **26 DEG por kg**, valor elevado en diciembre de 2024, lo que equivale a unos $35 por kg según los tipos de cambio.

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - En cuanto a la carga, ese límite se mantiene **incluso si la aerolínea fue gravemente negligente**. Las únicas formas de superarlo son declarar un valor mayor y pagar un recargo adicional al enviar, o contratar un seguro de carga por separado.

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - Los plazos son estrictos: las reclamaciones escritas deben presentarse en un plazo de **14 días** desde la recepción en caso de daños, y de **21 días** en caso de retraso, y las demandas judiciales deben interponerse en un plazo de **2 años**.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: A medical-device startup in Columbus, Ohio, sells precision sensor modules to a hospital group in Germany.
segments.tr: Una startup de dispositivos médicos de Columbus, Ohio, vende módulos de sensores de precisión a un grupo hospitalario en Alemania.

segments.src: The order is 200 kg of modules worth **$60,000**, flown from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt.
segments.tr: El pedido son 200 kg de módulos con un valor de **$60,000**, enviados desde el aeropuerto O'Hare de Chicago a Fráncfort.

segments.src: Their freight forwarder consolidates the shipment with other customers' freight under one master AWB and gives the startup a house AWB.
segments.tr: Su agente de carga consolida el envío con la carga de otros clientes bajo una AWB madre y entrega a la startup una AWB casa.

segments.src: At O'Hare, the boxes go into an LD3 container on a 777.
segments.tr: En O'Hare, las cajas se cargan en un contenedor LD3 de un 777.

segments.src: During transit a forklift punctures the container, and half the modules are crushed.
segments.tr: Durante el tránsito, una carretilla elevadora perfora el contenedor y se aplastan la mitad de los módulos.

segments.src: The hospital notes the damage on delivery, and the startup files a written claim within 14 days.
segments.tr: El hospital anota el daño en la entrega, y la startup presenta una reclamación escrita dentro de los 14 días.

segments.src: The airline is liable even without proof of fault.
segments.tr: La aerolínea es responsable aunque no se demuestre culpa.

segments.src: But the payout is capped:
segments.tr: Pero la indemnización está limitada:

segments.src: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000
segments.tr: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000

segments.src: That covers roughly **$7,000 of a $30,000 loss.** If the startup had declared a higher value on the AWB, or simply bought an all-risk cargo insurance policy (often a small fraction of a percent of the cargo value), it could have recovered close to the full amount.
segments.tr: Eso cubre aproximadamente **$7,000 de una pérdida de $30,000.** Si la startup hubiera declarado un valor mayor en la AWB, o simplemente contratado una póliza de seguro de carga a todo riesgo (a menudo una pequeña fracción de un porcentaje del valor de la carga), podría haber recuperado casi todo el importe.

segments.src: The lesson for anyone shipping high-value, lightweight goods is that the per-kilo cap is not built to protect you.
segments.tr: La lección para quien envía mercancía ligera y de alto valor es que el límite por kilo no está pensado para protegerle.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumen en 3 líneas

segments.src: 1. The **air waybill** is the contract and receipt for air cargo. Unlike an ocean bill of lading, it is non-negotiable, and the goods go to the named consignee.
segments.tr: 1. La **guía aérea** es el contrato y el recibo de la carga aérea. A diferencia del conocimiento de embarque marítimo, no es negociable, y la mercancía se entrega al consignatario indicado.

segments.src: 2. **ULDs** are pallets and containers shaped to fit aircraft holds, and freight is priced on **chargeable weight**, whichever is greater of actual or volumetric weight.
segments.tr: 2. Los **ULD** son palés y contenedores diseñados para encajar en las bodegas de los aviones, y el flete se calcula según el **peso tarifable**, que es el mayor entre el peso real y el peso volumétrico.

segments.src: 3. Under the **Montreal Convention**, airlines are liable for cargo damage without proof of fault but only up to **26 SDRs/kg**. For valuable goods, declare a higher value or insure them.
segments.tr: 3. Según el **Convenio de Montreal**, las aerolíneas responden por los daños a la carga sin necesidad de probar la culpa, pero solo hasta **26 DEG/kg**. Para la mercancía valiosa, declare un valor mayor o contrate un seguro.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de hoy

segments.src: - **Air Waybill (AWB)**: A non-negotiable contract of carriage and receipt for goods shipped by air, identified by an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: - **Guía aérea (AWB)**: Contrato de transporte no negociable y recibo de la mercancía enviada por vía aérea, identificado por un número de 11 dígitos.

segments.src: - **Master / House AWB**: The airline-to-forwarder waybill (master) and the forwarder-to-shipper waybill (house) used in consolidated shipments.
segments.tr: - **AWB madre / AWB casa**: La guía de la aerolínea al agente de carga (madre) y la del agente de carga al remitente (casa), utilizadas en envíos consolidados.

segments.src: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: A standardized aircraft pallet or container, such as the LD3, used to load cargo as a single unit.
segments.tr: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: Palé o contenedor estandarizado de aeronave, como el LD3, que se usa para cargar mercancía como una sola unidad.

segments.src: - **Chargeable weight**: Whichever is greater of actual weight and volumetric weight; the figure air freight is billed on.
segments.tr: - **Peso tarifable**: El mayor entre el peso real y el peso volumétrico; es la cifra por la que se factura el flete aéreo.

segments.src: - **Montreal Convention (1999)**: The international treaty setting airline liability rules, including a per-kg cap (currently 26 SDRs) for cargo loss, damage, or delay.
segments.tr: - **Convenio de Montreal (1999)**: Tratado internacional que establece las normas de responsabilidad de las aerolíneas, incluido un límite por kilo (actualmente 26 DEG) por pérdida, daño o retraso de la carga.

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: ومن الأمثلة الشائعة **LD3**، وهي حاوية تتسع لصفين جنبًا إلى جنب في الطابق السفلي للطائرات عريضة البدن مثل Boeing 777.

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: تتيح وحدات ULD لطاقم المناولة الأرضية تحميل مئات الصناديق كوحدة واحدة، ما يقلل وقت التحميل وتلف البضائع أثناء المناولة.

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للشحنات، فالقواعد الأساسية هي:

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - تتحمل شركة الطيران المسؤولية عن الهلاك أو الفقدان أو التلف أثناء النقل، **سواء كانت مخطئة أم لا**. ولا تُعفى من المسؤولية إلا لأسباب محددة، مثل عيب ذاتي في البضائع، أو تغليف معيب من طرف غير الناقل، أو الحرب، أو أعمال السلطات العامة (مثل الجمارك).

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - تُحدَّد المسؤولية **بحد أقصى لكل كيلوغرام**، مقاسًا بوحدات حقوق السحب الخاصة (SDR)، وهي وحدة صندوق النقد الدولي المستندة إلى سلة من العملات. ويُراجع الحد تقريبًا كل خمس سنوات. وهو حاليًا **26 SDR لكل كغ**، رُفع في ديسمبر 2024، ويعادل تقريبًا $35 للكيلوغرام حسب أسعار الصرف.

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - بالنسبة للشحنات، يظل هذا الحد ساريًا **حتى لو كانت شركة الطيران مهملة بشكل جسيم**. وطرق تجاوزه الوحيدة هي التصريح بقيمة أعلى ودفع رسوم إضافية عند الشحن، أو شراء تأمين منفصل على الشحنة.

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - المواعيد النهائية صارمة: يجب تقديم الشكاوى الكتابية خلال **14 يومًا** من الاستلام في حالة التلف، و**21 يومًا** في حالة التأخير، ويجب رفع الدعاوى خلال **سنتين**.

segments.src: A medical-device startup in Columbus, Ohio, sells precision sensor modules to a hospital group in Germany.
segments.tr: شركة ناشئة في مجال الأجهزة الطبية في كولومبوس بولاية أوهايو تبيع وحدات استشعار دقيقة لمجموعة مستشفيات في ألمانيا.

segments.src: The order is 200 kg of modules worth **$60,000**, flown from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt.
segments.tr: الطلب 200 كغ من الوحدات قيمتها **$60,000**، وتُنقل من مطار شيكاغو أوهير إلى فرانكفورت.

segments.src: Their freight forwarder consolidates the shipment with other customers' freight under one master AWB and gives the startup a house AWB.
segments.tr: يجمّع وكيل الشحن الخاص بالشركة شحنتها مع شحنات عملاء آخرين تحت بوليصة شحن رئيسية واحدة، ويُصدر للشركة بوليصة فرعية.

segments.src: At O'Hare, the boxes go into an LD3 container on a 777.
segments.tr: في مطار أوهير توضع الصناديق في حاوية LD3 على طائرة 777.

segments.src: During transit a forklift punctures the container, and half the modules are crushed.
segments.tr: أثناء النقل، تثقب رافعة شوكية الحاوية فتتهشم نصف الوحدات.

segments.src: The hospital notes the damage on delivery, and the startup files a written claim within 14 days.
segments.tr: يسجل المستشفى التلف عند التسليم، وتقدم الشركة مطالبة كتابية خلال 14 يومًا.

segments.src: The airline is liable even without proof of fault.
segments.tr: شركة الطيران مسؤولة حتى دون إثبات الخطأ.

segments.src: But the payout is capped:
segments.tr: لكن مبلغ التعويض محدود:

segments.src: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000
segments.tr: 200 kg x 26 SDR = 5,200 SDR ≈ about $7,000

segments.src: That covers roughly **$7,000 of a $30,000 loss.** If the startup had declared a higher value on the AWB, or simply bought an all-risk cargo insurance policy (often a small fraction of a percent of the cargo value), it could have recovered close to the full amount.
segments.tr: وهذا يغطي تقريبًا **$7,000 من خسارة قدرها $30,000.** لو صرّحت الشركة بقيمة أعلى في بوليصة الشحن، أو اشترت ببساطة وثيقة تأمين شامل على البضائع (وغالبًا ما تكون نسبة صغيرة جدًا من قيمة الشحنة)، لكانت استعادت ما يقارب المبلغ كاملًا.

segments.src: The lesson for anyone shipping high-value, lightweight goods is that the per-kilo cap is not built to protect you.
segments.tr: الدرس لأي شخص يشحن بضائع خفيفة وعالية القيمة أن الحد لكل كيلوغرام لم يُصمَّم لحمايتك.

segments.src: 1. The **air waybill** is the contract and receipt for air cargo. Unlike an ocean bill of lading, it is non-negotiable, and the goods go to the named consignee.
segments.tr: 1. **بوليصة الشحن الجوي** هي العقد والإيصال للشحن الجوي. وعلى عكس بوليصة الشحن البحري، فهي غير قابلة للتداول، وتُسلَّم البضائع إلى المرسَل إليه المذكور.

segments.src: 2. **ULDs** are pallets and containers shaped to fit aircraft holds, and freight is priced on **chargeable weight**, whichever is greater of actual or volumetric weight.
segments.tr: 2. **وحدات ULD** منصات وحاويات مصممة لتناسب حيز الطائرة، ويُسعَّر الشحن على **الوزن الخاضع للحساب**، أي الأعلى من الوزن الفعلي والوزن الحجمي.

segments.src: 3. Under the **Montreal Convention**, airlines are liable for cargo damage without proof of fault but only up to **26 SDRs/kg**. For valuable goods, declare a higher value or insure them.
segments.tr: 3. بموجب **اتفاقية مونتريال**، تتحمل شركات الطيران مسؤولية تلف البضائع دون إثبات الخطأ، لكن حتى **26 SDR/كغ** فقط. وبالنسبة للبضائع الثمينة، صرّح بقيمة أعلى أو أمّنها.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Air Waybill (AWB)**: A non-negotiable contract of carriage and receipt for goods shipped by air, identified by an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: - **بوليصة الشحن الجوي (AWB)**: عقد نقل وإيصال غير قابل للتداول للبضائع المشحونة جوًا، ويُعرَّف برقم مكون من 11 خانة.

segments.src: - **Master / House AWB**: The airline-to-forwarder waybill (master) and the forwarder-to-shipper waybill (house) used in consolidated shipments.
segments.tr: - **البوليصة الرئيسية / الفرعية (Master / House AWB)**: البوليصة بين شركة الطيران ووكيل الشحن (الرئيسية)، والبوليصة بين وكيل الشحن والشاحن (الفرعية)، وتُستخدم في الشحنات المجمّعة.

segments.src: - **ULD (Unit Load Device)**: A standardized aircraft pallet or container, such as the LD3, used to load cargo as a single unit.
segments.tr: - **ULD (وحدة تحميل الطائرة)**: منصة أو حاوية موحدة للطائرات، مثل LD3، تُستخدم لتحميل البضائع كوحدة واحدة.

segments.src: - **Chargeable weight**: Whichever is greater of actual weight and volumetric weight; the figure air freight is billed on.
segments.tr: - **الوزن الخاضع للحساب (Chargeable weight)**: الأعلى من الوزن الفعلي والوزن الحجمي، وهو الرقم الذي يُحتسب عليه الشحن الجوي.

segments.src: - **Montreal Convention (1999)**: The international treaty setting airline liability rules, including a per-kg cap (currently 26 SDRs) for cargo loss, damage, or delay.
segments.tr: - **اتفاقية مونتريال (1999)**: المعاهدة الدولية التي تحدد قواعد مسؤولية شركات الطيران، بما في ذلك حد أقصى لكل كيلوغرام (26 SDR حاليًا) عن فقدان البضائع أو تلفها أو تأخيرها.

fr.title: [Logistique internationale #9] Votre envoi de 60 000 $ a bien volé, alors pourquoi la compagnie aérienne ne vous doit-elle que 7 000 $ ?

segments.src: > Air cargo is fast but costly, and it runs on three things: a contract document (the air waybill), standardized containers (ULDs), and an international treaty (the Montreal Convention) that caps what an airline pays if something goes wrong.
segments.tr: > Le fret aérien est rapide mais coûteux, et il repose sur trois éléments : un document contractuel (la lettre de transport aérien), des conteneurs standardisés (ULD) et une convention internationale (la convention de Montréal) qui plafonne le montant qu'une compagnie aérienne doit payer en cas de problème.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Less than 1% of world trade by weight moves by air, yet that slice accounts for roughly a third of global trade by value.
segments.tr: Moins de 1 % du commerce mondial en poids transite par voie aérienne, mais cette part représente environ un tiers du commerce mondial en valeur.

segments.src: That makes sense: you fly things that are light, valuable, perishable, or urgent, such as smartphones, pharmaceuticals, fresh flowers, or a replacement part for a stalled factory line.
segments.tr: C'est logique : on expédie par avion des objets légers, de grande valeur, périssables ou urgents, comme des smartphones, des produits pharmaceutiques, des fleurs fraîches ou une pièce de rechange pour une ligne de production à l'arrêt.

segments.src: Three building blocks keep this system running.
segments.tr: Trois éléments fondamentaux font fonctionner ce système.

segments.src: The Air Waybill (AWB): the contract and the receipt.**
segments.tr: La lettre de transport aérien (LTA) : le contrat et le reçu.**

segments.src: Every air shipment travels under an AWB.
segments.tr: Chaque envoi aérien voyage sous une LTA.

segments.src: It shows that the airline received the goods, lays out the terms of carriage, and lists the shipper, consignee, weight, pieces, and charges.
segments.tr: Elle atteste que la compagnie a reçu la marchandise, définit les conditions du transport et mentionne l'expéditeur, le destinataire, le poids, le nombre de colis et les frais.

segments.src: Each AWB has an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: Chaque LTA porte un numéro à 11 chiffres.

segments.src: The first three digits are the airline's prefix (for example, 001 is American Airlines), and the remaining eight identify the shipment, so you can track it from start to finish.
segments.tr: Les trois premiers chiffres correspondent au préfixe de la compagnie (par exemple, 001 pour American Airlines), et les huit suivants identifient l'envoi, ce qui permet de le suivre de bout en bout.

segments.src: One key difference from ocean shipping: **an AWB is not a document of title.** A negotiable ocean bill of lading can be sold or handed over to transfer ownership of the goods.
segments.tr: Une différence essentielle avec le transport maritime : **une LTA n'est pas un titre de propriété.** Un connaissement maritime négociable peut être vendu ou transmis pour transférer la propriété de la marchandise.

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: Une LTA ne le peut pas.

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: La marchandise est remise au destinataire désigné sur le document.

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: Comme les avions arrivent en quelques heures et non en quelques semaines, personne n'a besoin de négocier la marchandise pendant le transport.

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: Vous entendrez aussi parler de deux niveaux de lettres de transport :

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **LTA maître (MAWB)** : émise par la compagnie aérienne à un transitaire, couvrant souvent les marchandises de nombreux clients regroupées.

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **LTA de groupage (HAWB)** : émise par le transitaire à chaque expéditeur individuel.

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: La plupart des LTA sont aujourd'hui électroniques (e-AWB) plutôt que sur papier.

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULD (Unit Load Devices) : les éléments de base de la soute.**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: Les soutes d'avion sont courbes et très compactes, on ne peut donc pas y charger un conteneur maritime standard de 40 pieds.

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: Les compagnies utilisent donc des ULD.

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de palettes en aluminium munies de filets, ou de conteneurs profilés épousant la forme du fuselage.

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: Un exemple courant est le **LD3**, un conteneur qui se place deux de front dans le pont inférieur des gros-porteurs comme le Boeing 777.

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: Les ULD permettent aux équipes au sol de charger des centaines de colis comme une seule unité, ce qui réduit le temps de chargement et les dommages liés à la manutention.

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: Comment le fret aérien est tarifé : le poids facturable.**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: L'espace disponible dans un avion est limité en volume comme en poids.

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: Les compagnies facturent donc le plus élevé entre le poids réel et le « poids volumétrique » calculé d'après les dimensions du colis.

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: Selon la norme courante de l'IATA :

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: Un gros carton d'oreillers peut coûter bien plus cher à transporter que ne le laisse supposer son poids sur la balance.

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: La convention de Montréal (1999) : qui paie en cas de problème.**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: Ce traité international régit la plupart des transports aériens internationaux, et les États-Unis

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: y sont partie.

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: Pour le fret, les règles principales sont les suivantes :

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - La compagnie est responsable de la destruction, de la perte ou de l'avarie survenue pendant le transport, **qu'elle soit fautive ou non**. Elle n'est exonérée que pour des motifs énumérés, par exemple un vice propre de la marchandise, un emballage défectueux effectué par un tiers et non par le transporteur, la guerre ou des actes de l'autorité publique (par exemple, la douane).

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - La responsabilité est **plafonnée par kilogramme**, exprimée en droits de tirage spéciaux (DTS), une unité du FMI fondée sur un panier de devises. La limite est réexaminée environ tous les cinq ans. Elle est actuellement de **26 DTS par kg**, relevée en décembre 2024, soit environ 35 $ par kg selon les taux de change.

pt.title: [International Logistics #9] Seu carregamento de $60,000 voou sem problemas — então por que a companhia aérea só deveria pagar $7,000?

segments.src: > Air cargo is fast but costly, and it runs on three things: a contract document (the air waybill), standardized containers (ULDs), and an international treaty (the Montreal Convention) that caps what an airline pays if something goes wrong.
segments.tr: > O transporte aéreo de carga é rápido, mas caro, e funciona com base em três elementos: um documento contratual (o conhecimento aéreo, ou air waybill), contêineres padronizados (ULDs) e um tratado internacional (a Convenção de Montreal) que limita o valor que a companhia aérea paga caso algo dê errado.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito do Dia

segments.src: Less than 1% of world trade by weight moves by air, yet that slice accounts for roughly a third of global trade by value.
segments.tr: Menos de 1% do comércio mundial em peso é transportado por via aérea, mas essa fatia responde por cerca de um terço do comércio global em valor.

segments.src: That makes sense: you fly things that are light, valuable, perishable, or urgent, such as smartphones, pharmaceuticals, fresh flowers, or a replacement part for a stalled factory line.
segments.tr: Faz sentido: despacha-se por avião itens leves, valiosos, perecíveis ou urgentes, como smartphones, produtos farmacêuticos, flores frescas ou uma peça de reposição para uma linha de produção parada.

segments.src: Three building blocks keep this system running.
segments.tr: Três elementos sustentam esse sistema.

segments.src: The Air Waybill (AWB): the contract and the receipt.**
segments.tr: O Conhecimento Aéreo (AWB): o contrato e o recibo.**

segments.src: Every air shipment travels under an AWB.
segments.tr: Toda remessa aérea viaja sob um AWB.

segments.src: It shows that the airline received the goods, lays out the terms of carriage, and lists the shipper, consignee, weight, pieces, and charges.
segments.tr: Ele comprova que a companhia aérea recebeu a mercadoria, estabelece as condições do transporte e relaciona remetente, consignatário, peso, volumes e encargos.

segments.src: Each AWB has an 11-digit number.
segments.tr: Cada AWB tem um número de 11 dígitos.

segments.src: The first three digits are the airline's prefix (for example, 001 is American Airlines), and the remaining eight identify the shipment, so you can track it from start to finish.
segments.tr: Os três primeiros dígitos são o prefixo da companhia aérea (por exemplo, 001 é a American Airlines), e os oito restantes identificam a remessa, permitindo rastreá-la do início ao fim.

segments.src: One key difference from ocean shipping: **an AWB is not a document of title.** A negotiable ocean bill of lading can be sold or handed over to transfer ownership of the goods.
segments.tr: Uma diferença fundamental em relação ao transporte marítimo: **o AWB não é um documento de título.** Um conhecimento de embarque marítimo negociável pode ser vendido ou transferido para passar a propriedade da mercadoria.

segments.src: An AWB can't.
segments.tr: O AWB não pode.

segments.src: The cargo is released to the consignee named on it.
segments.tr: A carga é entregue ao consignatário nele indicado.

segments.src: Because planes arrive in hours, not weeks, nobody needs to trade the goods while they're in transit.
segments.tr: Como os aviões chegam em horas, e não em semanas, ninguém precisa negociar a mercadoria enquanto ela está em trânsito.

segments.src: You will also hear about two layers of waybills:
segments.tr: Você também vai encontrar dois níveis de conhecimentos aéreos:

segments.src: - **Master AWB (MAWB)**: issued by the airline to a freight forwarder, often covering many customers' goods consolidated together.
segments.tr: - **AWB master (MAWB)**: emitido pela companhia aérea para um agente de carga (freight forwarder), muitas vezes abrangendo mercadorias de vários clientes consolidadas juntas.

segments.src: - **House AWB (HAWB)**: issued by the forwarder to each individual shipper.
segments.tr: - **AWB house (HAWB)**: emitido pelo agente de carga para cada remetente individual.

segments.src: Most AWBs today are electronic (e-AWB) instead of paper.
segments.tr: Hoje a maioria dos AWBs é eletrônica (e-AWB), e não em papel.

segments.src: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): the building blocks of the cargo hold.**
segments.tr: ULDs (Unit Load Devices): os blocos de construção do porão de carga.**

segments.src: Aircraft holds are curved and tightly packed, so you can't just roll in a standard 40-foot ocean container.
segments.tr: Os porões das aeronaves são curvos e muito compactos, por isso não é possível simplesmente rolar para dentro um contêiner marítimo padrão de 40 pés.

segments.src: Airlines use ULDs instead.
segments.tr: As companhias aéreas usam ULDs.

segments.src: These are aluminum pallets with nets, or contoured containers shaped to fit the fuselage.
segments.tr: São paletes de alumínio com redes ou contêineres com formato contornado para se adaptar à fuselagem.

segments.src: A common example is the **LD3**, a container that fits two-across in the lower deck of wide-body jets like the Boeing 777.
segments.tr: Um exemplo comum é o **LD3**, contêiner que cabe lado a lado duas unidades no porão inferior de jatos de fuselagem larga, como o Boeing 777.

segments.src: ULDs let ground crews load hundreds of boxes as a single unit, which cuts loading time and handling damage.
segments.tr: Os ULDs permitem que as equipes de solo carreguem centenas de caixas como uma única unidade, reduzindo o tempo de carregamento e os danos no manuseio.

segments.src: How air freight is priced: chargeable weight.**
segments.tr: Como o frete aéreo é precificado: peso tarifável.**

segments.src: Space on a plane is limited by volume as well as weight.
segments.tr: O espaço em um avião é limitado tanto pelo volume quanto pelo peso.

segments.src: Airlines therefore charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight, or a "volumetric weight" based on the box's size.
segments.tr: Por isso, as companhias cobram pelo maior valor entre o peso real e o "peso volumétrico", calculado a partir do tamanho da caixa.

segments.src: Under the common IATA standard:
segments.tr: Segundo o padrão comum da IATA:

segments.src: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000
segments.tr: Volumetric weight (kg) = Length x Width x Height (cm) / 6000

segments.src: A big box of pillows can cost far more to fly than its scale weight would suggest.
segments.tr: Uma caixa grande com travesseiros pode custar muito mais para ser transportada do que sugere seu peso na balança.

segments.src: The Montreal Convention (1999): who pays when things go wrong.**
segments.tr: A Convenção de Montreal (1999): quem paga quando algo dá errado.**

segments.src: This international treaty governs most international air carriage, and the U.S.
segments.tr: Este tratado internacional rege a maior parte do transporte aéreo internacional, e os EUA

segments.src: is a party to it.
segments.tr: são signatários.

segments.src: For cargo, the main rules are:
segments.tr: Para carga, as regras principais são:

segments.src: - The airline is liable for destruction, loss, or damage during carriage, **whether or not it was at fault**. It escapes liability only for listed reasons, such as an inherent defect of the goods, defective packing by someone other than the carrier, war, or acts of public authorities (e.g., customs).
segments.tr: - A companhia aérea responde por destruição, perda ou avaria durante o transporte, **mesmo sem ter culpa**. Ela se exime da responsabilidade apenas em hipóteses previstas, como vício intrínseco da mercadoria, embalagem defeituosa feita por terceiros que não o transportador, guerra ou atos de autoridades públicas (por exemplo, a alfândega).

segments.src: - Liability is **capped per kilogram**, measured in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), an IMF unit based on a basket of currencies. The limit is reviewed about every five years. It is currently **26 SDRs per kg**, raised in December 2024, which comes to roughly $35 per kg depending on exchange rates.
segments.tr: - A responsabilidade é **limitada por quilograma**, medida em Direitos Especiais de Saque (SDR), uma unidade do FMI baseada em uma cesta de moedas. O limite é revisado aproximadamente a cada cinco anos. Atualmente é de **26 SDR por kg**, valor elevado em dezembro de 2024, o que equivale a cerca de US$ 35 por kg, dependendo da taxa de câmbio.

segments.src: - For cargo, that cap holds **even if the airline was seriously negligent**. The only ways around it are to declare a higher value and pay a supplementary charge when shipping, or to buy separate cargo insurance.
segments.tr: - No caso de carga, esse teto se mantém **mesmo que a companhia aérea tenha agido com grave negligência**. As únicas formas de contorná-lo são declarar um valor maior no embarque, pagando uma taxa suplementar, ou contratar um seguro de carga separado.

segments.src: - Deadlines are strict: written complaints are due within **14 days** of receipt for damage and **21 days** for delay, and lawsuits must be filed within **2 years**.
segments.tr: - Os prazos são rígidos: reclamações por escrito devem ser apresentadas em até **14 dias** do recebimento, no caso de avaria, e **21 dias** no caso de atraso, e as ações judiciais devem ser ajuizadas em até **2 anos**.
